svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — The board, assembled
svg.desc: Design view, no kerf. 409.285 mm across. Four quadrants lock with three puzzle knobs per seam; the north-west one carries the centre square. Tortuga is a +-shaped 6 mm piece that sits on top of the board like the islands do — anchor and name in the middle, a berth on each arm — over a dotted outline that shows where it goes. Seams run along the grid lines, so every square is whole on one piece. Rim marks are the app's own wind chevron; the water is the art's brush strokes. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
